craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of containment — the Vijñānavāda opponent staged at full strength, then held; śāstra-hammer couplets, negation-anaphora, terminal doctrine words. Three bars in one line — compression IS the force: leans/keeps/oversteps, three strikes one breath. Rejected: (a) bars split across lines → killed: dilution. (b) unpacking naikarūpatva → killed: hyphen pressure keeps the Sanskrit pack. Read aloud: A-thing's-SELF can-NEV-er BE-mere OB-ject … O-ver-STEPS be-ing.

lines: A thing's self can never be mere object of showing-telling:
it leans on another, keeps no single form, oversteps being.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prakhyopākhyāviṣayatāpy arthasyātmā na yujyate parāpekṣitayā naikarūpatve sattvalaṅghanāt

reads_against.argmap: Can a thing's own self consist in being-an-object-of-appearing? → Appearing-objecthood cannot be a thing's self: dependence, formlessness, and excess rule it out.
c1_essence: Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8).
Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).
